resource_policy.scope: Round 02, one serial tiny worker; no large queue or GPU/API
resource_policy.justification: 01 compressor<=6GiB was a conservative proxy and remains frozen. Round02 reads actual macOS memory_pressure -Q availability (observed 33%, load2.98 before registration), uses >=25% available (4GiB on this16GiB host), and tightens each worker to10CPU seconds/256MiB with serialnice15. This revised criterion is explicit and does not claim unrelated_project performance is unaffected.
resource_policy.forbidden: No signals/reprioritization of other tasks; no installs, GPU/API, reserve/test access, or old-source writes.
